title: Quantum mechanics I
purpose: Solve basic quantum eigenvalue problems and calculate probabilities from normalized states.

blocks.deliverable: Distinguish stationary states from stationary probability density.
Apply continuity conditions and check limiting cases.
Week 7 midterm; compute commutators and measurement statistics.
Derive energy spacing and normalize a state.
Calculate simple quantum numbers and selection constraints.
Submit analytic and numerical work and take a QM final.

project: Solve and numerically verify a one dimensional bound state model with an explicit normalization check.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
